# WEB INVITES — Digital Wedding Invitation Platform

## About
WEB INVITES is a digital wedding invitation platform that allows users to create interactive, mobile-friendly wedding websites in minutes. We offer 25+ handcrafted templates for various wedding traditions including Hindu, Nikah/Islamic, Christian, South Indian, and Royal celebrations.

## What We Offer
- **Free Tier**: Create 1 digital wedding invitation for free with ads. After 21 days, upgrade to premium to keep it live.
- **Premium Tier**: ₹399 one-time payment for ad-free hosting until 3 days after your event date.
- **Templates**: 25+ professionally designed templates across categories: Royal & Traditional, Floral & Botanical, Modern & Minimal, South Indian & Heritage, Birthday, and House Warming.
- **Features**: Google Maps integration, live countdown timer, WhatsApp RSVP, couple photo uploads, multi-event program schedules, inline editing.

## Pricing
- Free: 1 invitation with ads (21-day hosting)
- Premium: ₹399 per invitation, ad-free, hosted until 3 days after event

## How It Works
1. Browse and select a template from our collection
2. Customize couple names, wedding date, venue, photos, and details
3. Publish for free (with ads) or pay ₹399 for ad-free premium
4. Share the invitation link via WhatsApp, SMS, or social media

## Key Features
- **Live Countdown Timer**: Real-time countdown to the wedding day
- **Google Maps Directions**: One-tap navigation to the venue
- **WhatsApp RSVP**: Guests can confirm attendance via WhatsApp
- **Photo Upload**: Couple photos compressed to under 200KB automatically
- **Multi-Event Schedule**: Support for Haldi, Mehendi, Muhurtham, Reception timings
- **Mobile-First Design**: Optimized for smartphones where 95%+ of guests view invitations
- **Instant Updates**: Edit your live invitation and changes appear immediately

- Couples planning weddings in India and Indian diaspora worldwide

- Primary: India (all states)
- Secondary: UAE, USA, UK, Canada, Singapore, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia
- Languages: English, Hindi, Malayalam (additional languages planned)

## Contact
- Website: https://www.webinvites.shop
- Email: support@webinvites.shop

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js 14 (React)
- Supabase for database and authentication
- Google OAuth for sign-in
- Razorpay for payments (UPI, Cards, Netbanking)
- Hosted on Hostinger VPS
- SSL encrypted (HTTPS)
- GDPR compliant with cookie consent
